ghs.en: I think I want them to vanish, but,
ghs.assessment: The speaker says only that he wants to disappear. The English changes the object to an unspecified plural 'them' and adds an unfinished adversative clause.
ghs.remedy: All I can think is that I want to disappear.

highlights.text: I think I want them to vanish, but,

rows.jp: 思うことを、避けられない。

ghs.en: I cannot avoid the act of thinking itself.

rows.jp: 確か……今日は日曜日だ。

ghs.en: I'm sure... today is Sunday.

rows.jp: 頭がスッキリしていた。

ghs.en: My head felt refreshed and clear,

rows.jp: 昨日、そう昨日、全て吐き出したせいだ。
rows.en: Because yesterday—yes, yesterday—I emptied myself completely.

ghs.en: because yesterday, yeah, yesterday, I had spurted out everything.

rows.jp: 欲情が去れば、理性が戻る。

ghs.en: When sexual desires leave, rationality returns.

rows.jp: その意味で、曜子ちゃんはミスをしたんだと言える。
rows.en: In that sense, Youko’s made a mistake.

ghs.en: In that sense, it could be said that Youko-chan has made a mistake.

rows.jp: 「……取れないか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...can I remove them?"

rows.jp: 鎖はその接地部分がもっとも脆い。
rows.en: The chain is weakest where it meets the floor.

ghs.en: In chains, the part that connects to the ground is the most fragile.

rows.jp: 持続的に力をかけてきたが、取れる様子はない。
rows.en: I’ve kept pulling at it, but it won’t budge.

ghs.en: I applied continuous strength, but there is no taking them out.

rows.jp: となると……やっぱりジョーカーしかないんだ。
rows.en: Then... I’ve got nothing left but the joker.

ghs.en: And if it comes to this... indeed I gotta use the Joker, it can't be anything else.

rows.jp: 憂鬱になる。

ghs.en: I become melancholic.

rows.jp: 一度は半身とした相手だ。
rows.en: She was once my other half.

ghs.en: This enemy was once half of my own body.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese calls Youko the person or partner whom Taichi once made his other half. It does not call her an enemy.

rows.jp: 裏切り、になるのかな。

ghs.en: And I wonder, will this still be a betrayal?

rows.jp: けど……やっぱり……消えるのはいやだ。
rows.en: But... even so... I don’t want to disappear.

ghs.en: But... no... no, vanishing would be bad.

rows.jp: 自分に負けたまま、振り出しに戻されるのはつらい。
rows.en: Losing to myself and being sent back to square one—I couldn’t take that.

ghs.en: It hurts to be sent to the drawing board with my self still undefeated.
ghs.assessment: Taichi says that he is still defeated by himself. The English reverses the result and calls the self undefeated.

rows.jp: 自分に打ち克つのは克己って書くくらいで難しいんだけど……さ。
rows.en: They don’t call it self-conquest for nothing—beating yourself is hard... but still.

ghs.en: To surmount the self is nearly as difficult as pronouncing the words 'self control', but... well.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese remarks that the written word for self-mastery literally contains the characters for overcoming oneself. It says nothing about pronunciation, so the English invents a different and incoherent comparison.
ghs.remedy: hard enough that the word for self-mastery is written 'overcome oneself'

highlights.text: nearly as difficult as pronouncing the words 'self control'

rows.jp: 俺は自分、嫌いだから。

ghs.en: It's because I... hate myself.

rows.jp: 嫌いなやつには、負けたくない。
rows.en: And I refuse to lose to someone I hate.

ghs.en: And I don't want to lose to a guy I hate.

rows.jp: 曜子ちゃんのこと、嫌いではないけど。

ghs.en: Youko-chan I don't hate, but,

rows.jp: 傷つけるしかない。
rows.en: But I have no choice but to hurt her.

ghs.en: I can't but wound.

rows.jp: 彼女にも、弱点はある。

ghs.en: She has a weak point as well.

rows.jp: 突いた一点から、容易に崩壊へと至る、致命的な傷だ。
rows.en: A fatal wound: strike that one spot, and she’ll fall apart.

ghs.en: A thrust at this one point will easily led towards a downfall, so it will be a fatal wound.

rows.jp: 目を閉じる。考える。
rows.en: I close my eyes and think.

ghs.en: I close my eyes. And think,

rows.jp: はじめて出会った時から、今に至るまでを。
rows.en: From our first meeting to this moment.

ghs.en: about the time from the moment we first met, up until reaching the present.

rows.jp: 目を開く。迷いはない。
rows.en: I open my eyes. No more hesitation.

ghs.en: I open my eyes. No indecision.

rows.jp: ごめん、曜子ちゃん。

ghs.en: Sorry, Youko-chan,

rows.jp: 俺は、卑怯なことをします。
rows.en: I’m about to do something cowardly.

ghs.en: I shall be doing something unfair.

rows.jp: そして―――

ghs.en: And then---

rows.jp: 「おはよう」

ghs.en: Youko: "'morning."
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 「……からだ、拭くから」

ghs.en: Youko: "...after I wipe your body."
ghs.assessment: Youko announces that she is going to wipe Taichi's body. The English changes the statement into a subordinate 'after' clause with no main clause.

rows.jp: 「最後くらいは、キレイでいたいでしょう？」
rows.en: “You want to be clean for the end, don’t you?”

ghs.en: Youko: "This is the end, and you want to be clean, right?"
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: そして、作業を終えて彼女は言った。

ghs.en: And then, once the work was finished, she said:

rows.jp: 「これでお別れ」

ghs.en: Youko: "This is a farewell."
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 「現象になった私たちに、無駄な感傷は必要ない……けど」
rows.en: “Once we’re a phenomenon, we won’t need pointless sentiment... but...”

ghs.en: Youko: "To the two of us that have become phenomenon, useless sentimentality is unnecessary... but,"

rows.jp: 「……太一……ごめんなさい」

ghs.en: Youko: "...Taichi... I am sorry."

rows.jp: 「固有のあなたをすべて保持する方法はない」
rows.en: “There’s no way to preserve every part of this unique you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "There is no method to preserve your entire eigenself."

rows.jp: 「だから……最後に一度だけ」
rows.en: “So... just this once, at the end...”

ghs.en: Youko: "Therefore... only this once, at the end."
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 「一緒に来て」

ghs.en: Youko: "Come with me."

rows.jp: 懇願。

ghs.en: A supplication.

rows.jp: 彼女のそうした態度には、少し驚かされた。
rows.en: I’m a little surprised to hear her plead.

ghs.en: I was a bit surprised at this attitude of hers.

rows.jp: 「今の個体が傷むまでは……二人で同じ時を過ごせる……」
rows.en: “Until this version of you wears out... the two of us can share the same time...”

ghs.en: Youko: "Let us spend the same time together, the two of us... until the individuality we have now has rotten away..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese refers to their present individual bodies or forms wearing out. 'Individuality' instead means a personal quality, and the English also uses the wrong participle after 'has.'
ghs.remedy: until our present bodies wear out

highlights.text: until the individuality we have now has rotten away

rows.jp: 「永遠ではないけど」

ghs.en: Youko: "Eternity it won't be, however."

rows.jp: 「私たちにとって有用な時間になると思う」
rows.en: “I think that time would be useful to us.”

ghs.en: Youko: "It will become a serviceable time for us, I think."
Youko: "...Taichi?"

rows.jp: その申し出は、ありがたいけど。
rows.en: I am grateful for the offer.

ghs.en: I am thankful for your offer, but,

rows.jp: 俺は……。

ghs.en: Taichi: "......"
Youko: "...indeed."

rows.jp: 沈黙を否定と受け取り、彼女は小さく息を落とした。
rows.en: Taking my silence for refusal, she lets out a small breath.

ghs.en: Accepting the silence as refusal, she let loose a tiny sigh.

rows.jp: 「じゃあ太一、また来週」
rows.en: “Then, Taichi. I’ll see you next week.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Well, Taichi, see you next week."

rows.jp: 「覚えてはいないでしょうけど」

ghs.en: Youko: "You will not remember this, though."

rows.jp: そして出て行く。

ghs.en: And then she goes to leave.

rows.jp: 口を、開く。

ghs.en: My mouth... opens.
Taichi: "...wimp."

rows.jp: ぴたりと、彼女は止まった。

ghs.en: On that exact spot she came to a halt.
Youko: "...eh?"

rows.jp: 「弱虫って言ったんだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "I said you're a wimp."

rows.jp: 「それで、裏切り者」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And because of that, a traitor."
ghs.assessment: The connective continues the list with 'and' or 'also.' The English invents a causal claim that the preceding point made her a traitor.

rows.jp: 振り返った顔が、蝋人形にも見えた。
rows.en: She turns, her face like a wax doll’s.

ghs.en: The face that looked back at me yet resembled a wax model.
Youko: "......Taichi."

rows.jp: 笑ってみせる。

ghs.en: I show her a smile,

rows.jp: わずかの悪意をこめて。
rows.en: With just a trace of malice.

ghs.en: one that contains only a bit of malice.

rows.jp: 「忘れたとでも思ってたの？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You thought I had somehow forgot, right?"

rows.jp: 「ショックで、全部どっか飛んでいったとでも？」
rows.en: “That the shock had blown everything out of my head?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That it all had flown away somewhere because of shock?"

rows.jp: 「……記憶してるさ。全部ね」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...I have memories. Of everything, yes."

rows.jp: 「それとも、触れるわけないって思ってた？」
rows.en: “Or did you think I’d never bring it up?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Or maybe, were you just thinking I would never bring this up?"

rows.jp: 「俺の考え方だと、ありえないとでも？」
rows.en: “That someone who thinks the way I do couldn’t possibly do it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That it would never possibly happen, because of the way I think?"

rows.jp: 凍てつく幼なじみに、言葉を叩きつけていく。
rows.en: My childhood friend stands frozen as I hammer her with words.

ghs.en: I smack these words into my frozen childhood friend.

rows.jp: 「俺は、君が好きだった……本当に好きだったんだ」
rows.en: “I loved you... I truly loved you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I loved you... I seriously loved you."

rows.jp: 記憶は、一気に幼児期に戻る。

ghs.en: Recollections return to the time of infancy in a single stroke.

rows.jp: 「図書室で出会う、話したこともない君が」
rows.en: “You, the girl I used to see in the library. I’d never even spoken to you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But the you that I met in the library, with whom I never had a conversation."

rows.jp: 「ぴんと背筋を伸ばして、誰とも交わらずに、ただ自分だけを見つめて」
rows.en: “Back straight, keeping apart from everyone, looking only inward.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Head held high with back tense and straight, not associating nor mingling nor crossing with anyone, eyes fixed exclusively on yourself and nothing else."

rows.jp: 「そういう君が好きだったんだよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "That is the you that I loved!"

rows.jp: 「ただ、自分が仲良くしたいとは思わなかった」
rows.en: “I just didn’t want to get close to you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Just, I never thought I would want to become good friends with you."

rows.jp: 「接触する必要はなかったからさ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because there was no need for direct contact, that's why."

rows.jp: 「でも、君はどうしようもなく追いつめられて、壊れかけてた」
rows.en: “But you were driven into a corner. Nearly broken.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But you were helplessly and powerlessly driven into a corner, and about to be shattered."

rows.jp: 「そりゃちょっとくらい同情はするさ。何があったのかなんて知ってたし、少なくとも当時は俺だって今よりはまともだったんだから」
rows.en: “Sure, I felt a little sorry for you. I knew what had happened, and I was at least more together then than I am now.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And that's well, I'm kinda-sorta sympathetic ya know. What happened I sort of know, and at least at that time I was way more upstanding than I am now."

rows.jp: 「だから、暗黙の了解を破った」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And therefore, what you did was violate an unspoken agreement."
ghs.assessment: In context Taichi says that he himself therefore broke their tacit agreement. The English assigns the violation to Youko.

highlights.text: what you did was violate an unspoken agreement

rows.jp: 「……やめて」

ghs.en: Youko: "...stop."

rows.jp: 弱々しく震える声。
rows.en: Her voice is weak and trembling.

ghs.en: A weakly, feminine, shaking voice.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese describes a weak, trembling voice. The English adds that it is feminine and uses the adverb 'weakly' where an adjective is required.

rows.jp: 「声をかけたんだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You called out to me."
ghs.assessment: In context Taichi says that he called out to Youko. The English reverses the speaker and recipient.

rows.jp: 「太一」

ghs.en: Youko: "Taichi."

rows.jp: 「俺はたった一人の味方だったんだろ？　あの屋敷で」
rows.en: “I was your only ally in that mansion, wasn’t I?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was your single solitary ally, right? In that whole mansion."

rows.jp: 「だから、急に意識するようになったんだ」
rows.en: “That’s why you suddenly started noticing me.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And you came to realize that quickly."

rows.jp: 「……事の起こりなんて、どうでもいい」

ghs.en: Youko: "...how it came to be is unimportant."

rows.jp: 「私は太一を選んだだけ」

ghs.en: Youko: "I simply chose you, Taichi."

rows.jp: 持ち直した彼女が、内心の怯えを屈服させて、発言する。
rows.en: She masters the fear within her and recovers enough to answer.

ghs.en: Having gotten a hold on herself, she makes the terror in her heart yield, and speaks.

rows.jp: たいしたもので声の張りは一定だ。
rows.en: It’s impressive how steady her voice is.

ghs.en: Impressive how uniform her voice is.

rows.jp: 「その心の機微を、言語化しようとは思わない」
rows.en: “I don’t intend to put every nuance of that feeling into words.”

ghs.en: Youko: "I never intended to verbalize the delicate workings of my heart."

rows.jp: 「好きで、愛してる」

ghs.en: Youko: "I like you, so I love you."

rows.jp: 「二人は一心同体。切ることの出来ない絆」
rows.en: “We are one body and soul. A bond that cannot be cut.”

ghs.en: Youko: "We are alter egos. It's a bond that cannot be severed."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that the pair are one in body and soul. 'Alter egos' describes alternate selves and does not convey their inseparable union.

rows.jp: 「それで、いいと思う」

ghs.en: Youko: "That is enough, I think."

rows.jp: 「俺はそうは思わないね」

ghs.en: Taichi: "I don't think that, you know."

rows.jp: 「君は……誰でも良かったんだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You... would've be fine with anyone, that's what."
ghs.assessment: The perfect conditional requires the past participle 'been,' not the base form 'be.'

rows.jp: 「味方であって有能であれば、誰だって」
rows.en: “Anyone capable enough, as long as they were on your side.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "As long as it's an ally, and there's competence, whoever."

rows.jp: 「選んだ？　違うさ。自動的だったんだ。俺しかいなかったんだから」
rows.en: “You chose me? No. It was automatic. There wasn’t anyone else.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Chose me? Not even close. It was automatic. It was because there was me and no one else."

rows.jp: 「その結果、どうなった？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And the outcome of that was... what?"

rows.jp: 「君は自立しなくなって、俺は……怪物になって」
rows.en: “You stopped standing on your own, and I... became a monster.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You stopped being self-reliant, and I... became a monster."
Taichi: "And then---"
Youko: "...STOP!"

rows.jp: はじめて。

ghs.en: For the very first time,

rows.jp: 彼女は激情を示した。

ghs.en: the girl showed a violent emotion.

rows.jp: それは恐怖の領域だよ、曜子ちゃん―――
rows.en: You have entered the realm of fear, Youko—

ghs.en: That is the dominion of fear, Youko-chan---

rows.jp: 「事実だ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's the truth."

rows.jp: 「俺は、一日も忘れたことない。あれが俺のルーツだからね」
rows.en: “I haven’t forgotten it for a single day. It’s where I began.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I have not forgotten, not for one day. Because those are my roots."

rows.jp: 「一心同体。確かにそういう約束をした」
rows.en: “One body and soul. Yes, we made that promise.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Alter egos, yes, we certainly made that promise."

rows.jp: 「……一心同体というのはさ、互いを完全に肯定しあうものだよ」
rows.en: “Being one body and soul means accepting each other completely.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...but being alter egos means to assert to each other completely."
ghs.assessment: Taichi defines being one in body and soul as mutually affirming or accepting each other completely. 'Assert to each other' does not express that acceptance.

highlights.text: means to assert to each other completely

rows.jp: じり、と一歩下がる曜子ちゃん。

ghs.en: Inching, Youko-chan takes one step backwards.

rows.jp: 「あの日」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And that day..."

rows.jp: 「俺と君が、手を取り合った日」
rows.en: “The day you and I joined hands.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That day when you and I joined hands..."

rows.jp: 「入念に仕掛けて……準備して、新川の連中を皆殺しにしようとした日」
rows.en: “The day we laid our plans, prepared everything, and tried to massacre every member of the Shinkawa family.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That day when we carefully laid out traps... when we were ready, desiring to go massacre the Shinkawas and the rest..."

rows.jp: 「復讐の日！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...that day of vengeance!"

rows.jp: 「君が言い出したことじゃないか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "That was something you proposed, wasn't it."

rows.jp: 「自分がやろうとしたことだろう？」
rows.en: “It was what you meant to do, wasn’t it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That was something you wanted to do yourself, right?"

rows.jp: 「本来の曜子ちゃんなら、一人でやり遂げようとしたはずだ！」
rows.en: “The real Youko would’ve tried to finish it herself!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The original Youko-chan would have certainly have wanted to do by herself!"
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that the original Youko would have tried to carry the task through alone. The English duplicates the auxiliary and weakens accomplishment into merely wanting to do something.
ghs.remedy: would certainly have tried to see it through by herself

highlights.text: would have certainly have wanted to do by herself

rows.jp: 「けど君は俺を頼った！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "But you asked it of me!"
Taichi: "And then---"

rows.jp: 「……違う、違う違う！」

ghs.en: Youko: "...wrong, wrongwrong!"

rows.jp: 「それは……違うの……」

ghs.en: Youko: "That is... wrong..."

rows.jp: 「違わないよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "That's not wrong."

rows.jp: 選ばれた言葉が、装填される。
rows.en: The chosen words slide into the chamber.

ghs.en: The words chosen were loaded,

rows.jp: 獣を撃ち殺す必殺の弾丸。
rows.en: A killing round for the beast.

ghs.en: loaded with a bullet that can without fail shoot a beast to death.

rows.jp: 自分のため。自分が自分であるため。明日のため。来週のため。来週の月曜日に諸々のことを後悔したり、来週の土曜日に懐かしい思い出に浸ったりするため。
rows.en: For myself. To stay myself. For tomorrow. For next week. To regret this and that next Monday, and lose myself in fond memories next Saturday.

ghs.en: For the sake of my own self. For the sake of myself remaining my own self. For the sake of tomorrow. For the sake of Next Week.

rows.jp: そして。俺と俺の好きなものが、俺と俺の好きなものであり続けるため。
rows.en: So I can go on being myself, and the things I love can go on being the things I love.

rows.jp: 生涯で最後の交差(すれちがい)のため。
rows.en: For the last crossing of my life—the last time we pass each other by.

ghs.en: For the sake of the very last Crossing, without Meeting, of my entire life.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese refers only to the final crossing or intersection of Taichi's life. The English invents 'without Meeting' and turns the simple image into an unsupported title-like construction.

rows.jp: 俺は引き金を引いた―――

ghs.en: I pulled the trigger---

rows.jp: 「君はあの日、ただの一人も殺していないんだからね」
rows.en: “That day, you did not kill a single person.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "On that day, you didn't even kill one single person."

rows.jp: 支倉曜子が放射状に割れた。

ghs.en: Hasekura Youko shattered radially.

rows.jp: 「……全員、俺が殺した」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...all of them, I killed all of them."

rows.jp: 「罠と、炎と、刃物で」

ghs.en: Taichi: "By trap and by fire and by blade."

rows.jp: 「ぜんぶ俺が殺したんじゃないか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was the one that killed all of them, wasn't I?"

rows.jp: 「君は何もしなかったじゃないか！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You didn't do absolutely nothing, didn't you!"
Youko: "...NOOO!"

rows.jp: 叫ぶ。

ghs.en: Shouting.

rows.jp: 叫べるだけ、まだ強い。
rows.en: She can still scream. She’s still strong.

ghs.en: All that is still strong in her is the shouting.

rows.jp: あの時、殺ったのは俺だけだ―――
rows.en: I alone did the killing that day—

ghs.en: At that time, the one who killed all those people was me alone---

rows.jp: １００％、彼女のために殺ったのだ。
rows.en: I killed them entirely for her.

ghs.en: And 100% of those killings were for her sake.

rows.jp: 「……怯えていただけだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...you were just terrified."

rows.jp: 「それだけなら……まだいい」
rows.en: “If that was all... I could’ve lived with it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But that'd been all... that'd still be OK."

rows.jp: 「俺は君が解放されて、元に戻ってくれるだけで満足だった」
rows.en: “I just wanted you to be free. To be yourself again. That would’ve been enough.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "If only I had been released by you, and let me go back to what I was, that alone would have satisfied me."

ghs.remedy: I would have been satisfied just for you to be freed and return to normal.

highlights.text: If only I had been released by you, and let me go back to what I was, that alone would have satisfied me.

rows.jp: 「……すべてを終えて……戻った俺を見て……」
rows.en: “...But when it was over... when you saw me come back...”

rows.en: The only knot that never came undone.

Youko: "......that's... wrong..."

rows.jp: 「あの瞬間、俺の価値観は崩壊した」

rows.jp: 「好きだよ、愛してる。書類上はね」

highlights.text: People like you who exist at the very summit don't want anything as degenerate as love!

ghs.en: Taichi: "Tossing away long hours, preserving me..."

rows.jp: 「どんな俺なら気が済むんだよ」
rows.en: “What kind of me would finally satisfy you?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "What kind of me would you even be satisfied with!"

rows.jp: 「俺たちは君の言うような同体関係じゃないんだよ」
rows.en: “We’re not one being, no matter what you say.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Our relationship isn't like the alter egos you talk about."

ghs.en: Taichi: "And then you pretend not to notice this rudimentary deceit."

rows.en: “...Is that acceptable? Is that acceptable to you?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...will you permit it? That is, is this something you will permit yourself? Well?"

rows.jp: 「支倉曜子はそれを許すわけ？」
rows.en: “Would Youko Hasekura allow such a thing?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Is that something that Hasekura Youko will permit herself?"

rows.jp: 「君がとどまってるこのステージはさ、てんで低いものじゃないか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "The stage you are confining yourself to, you know, isn't it a cheap and low thing?"

rows.jp: 「……俺の知ってる曜子ちゃんが、それを許すとは思えないな」
rows.en: “...The Youko I know wouldn’t stand for that.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...I'd never think that the Youko-chan I know would ever allow that of herself."

rows.jp: 「……太一、よして……お願いだから……」

ghs.en: Youko: "...Taichi, cease this... I'm begging you..."

rows.en: “You tried to use me, and failed.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You made a mistake, you know, when you went to go make use of me."

rows.en: “Me, the ally who’d take your side no matter what, until your heart healed.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Of this myself that would have become an unconditional ally, until the heart had healed."

rows.jp: 「便利な手駒としての、精密な俺」
rows.en: “Me, the precision instrument. A useful pawn.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That precise myself, the one useful as a game piece."

rows.jp: 「そしてこの目」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And then, of these eyes."

rows.en: “In that situation, you only had one choice.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "For you, in that environment, the choice was one and only one."

ghs.remedy: unable to make even a single movement

highlights.text: unable to make but one movement

rows.en: “When a person is afraid, there are only two choices.”

rows.en: “Erase it, or make it part of you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Erase it completely, or assimilate it completely."

ghs.en: Taichi: "That is a matter demanded by a system that exists in the mind."

rows.en: “Not a feeling. A system of self-preservation.”

rows.en: “You let yourself decay, damaged me, and wanted us to be a phenomenon.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "How about... going home already?"

rows.en: “I don’t want to go back. I will stay with you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "I don't wanna go home! I wanna be together!"

ghs.remedy: Precisely because you're so capable and strong-willed, you can't defy an idea once it becomes fixed.

ghs.en: Taichi: "It completely becomes an automatism."

ghs.en: Taichi: "Take off the chains."

ghs.en: Youko-chan does not move.

ghs.en: Taichi: "I told you to take them off."

ghs.en: She leaves the room, and brings back the key.

rows.en: Her trembling hands open the lock.

ghs.en: Shaking hands undid the lock.

ghs.en: I was set free.

rows.en: “...I’m going to live. As the person I am now.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...I will live. Like I am now."

rows.en: “Want to try stopping me by force? I don’t think I’d lose now.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Wanna try to stop me with force? Because right now, I don't feel like I'd lose."

rows.en: “But... even if I return to a world without you...”

ghs.en: Youko: "But... to go back to a world without Taichi..."

rows.en: “If you choose the former, I will send you back by force.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Should you choose the former, I will forcibly repatriate you."

rows.en: “And in my heart, I’ll cut all ties with you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Aaah..."

ghs.en: Youko: "...either way... bad..."

rows.en: “Don’t put your heart in someone else’s hands!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don'tcha make other people into a pretext for your own heart!"

rows.en: I put a hand on her shoulder.

ghs.en: I lay hand on that shoulder.

ghs.en: Taichi: "You're gonna be living alone, until the day you die."

ghs.en: Taichi: "All people do, you know."

rows.jp: 「でも当時の君は、カンフル剤として純粋なものを必要としていたから……」
rows.en: “But back then, you needed a shot of something pure to keep you going...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But because at that time you needed something pure to be a shot of adrenaline for you..."

rows.jp: 「やっぱり、手近な俺を利用する可能性は高かった」
rows.en: “So chances are, you still would’ve used me. I was right there.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Indeed, the likelihood you'd have used what was underhand, me, was high."
ghs.assessment: Taichi calls himself the person who was nearby or readily at hand. 'Underhand' incorrectly characterizes him as deceitful.

rows.jp: 「使ったあとで切りすてればよかったのに」
rows.en: “You should’ve thrown me away once you were done with me.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But I wish you had just cut me off and cast me away right after using me."

rows.jp: 「それでも、俺は君を好きでい続けただろうから」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because even then, I would have continued to love you."

rows.jp: 「それで寂しくないの？」

ghs.en: Youko: "Is that not lonely?"

rows.jp: 「相手から何も与えられない……寂しくはならない？」
rows.en: “Nothing from the other person... wouldn’t you get lonely?”

ghs.en: Youko: "If you're given nothing from your partner... will it not become lonely?"

rows.jp: 「……キレイなものを見るのが、好きなんだよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...what I like is to look at what is beautiful."

rows.jp: 「まずそれがあるんだ。ずっと昔から」
rows.en: “That’s where it starts. It always has.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That's the first thing. Has been all the way from the beginning."

rows.jp: 「その気持ちだけが、俺の最初の感情なんだ」
rows.en: “That was the first thing I ever felt. Just that.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That very feeling was my very first emotion."

rows.jp: 「だから、平気だよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And so, it'll be alright!"

rows.jp: 「……もし……太一がまた向こう側に戻ってきたら……」
rows.en: “...If you ever come back to the other side...”

ghs.en: Youko: "...if... you once again were to return to the other side, Taichi..."

rows.jp: 「私、再挑戦する」

ghs.en: Youko: "I would try for you again."

rows.jp: 「うん」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Sure!"

rows.jp: 「その頃には、日本の王様くらいになってないとね、曜子ちゃん」
rows.en: “By then, you’d better be king of Japan at the very least, Youko.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And when I do, you better have become at least the King of Japan, Youko-chan."

rows.jp: 「……それは大変、すぎるかな」
rows.en: “...That might be a little too much.”

ghs.en: Youko: "...that may be... excessively problematic."

rows.jp: 「王制にしないといけないから」
rows.en: “I’d have to make it a monarchy.”

ghs.en: Youko: "I would have to impose a monarchical system."

rows.jp: 「違いない」

ghs.en: Taichi: "No kidding!"

rows.jp: 笑う。

ghs.en: I smile,

rows.jp: 彼女は、うつむいたままだった。

ghs.en: the girl remained downcast.

rows.jp: 「さようなら、支倉曜子」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Sayonara, Hasekura Youko."

rows.jp: 「孤高の君―――」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You who stand above---"

rows.jp: 恭しく頭を下げて。

ghs.en: A reverent bow, down to the waist.
Youko: "...good... b-..."

rows.jp: 泣き顔を見た。

ghs.en: I saw her crying face.

rows.jp: 俺はそれで一気に満足してしまって。
rows.en: And just like that, I’m completely satisfied.

ghs.en: And that, in a single stroke, left me completely satisfied.

rows.jp: 目を閉じた。

ghs.en: I closed my eyes.
Youko: "......ah!"

rows.jp: 「……胸、痛いんだ……失恋って……」
rows.en: “...My chest hurts... So this is heartbreak...”

ghs.en: Youko: "...breast, hurts... it's a broken heart..."

rows.jp: 「知らなかった……」

ghs.en: Youko: "I didn't know..."
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: しばらく、俺は佇んでいた。
rows.en: For a while, I remain standing there.

ghs.en: For a while I stood still.

rows.jp: 達成感。

ghs.en: A sense of accomplishment,

rows.jp: 喪失感。

ghs.en: a sense of loss,

rows.jp: いりまじってしまって、処理できない。
rows.en: They’re all mixed up. I don’t know what to do with them.

ghs.en: that mixed and entangled, in ways I couldn't manage.

rows.jp: やがて―――

ghs.en: And soon afterwards---

rows.jp: 「うわああああああああああああああああああああああああっ！！」

ghs.en:
Taichi: "UhwAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAAAh!!!"

rows.jp: 空に叫ぶ。

ghs.en: A shout to the sky.

rows.jp: 意味はない。

ghs.en: No meaning to it,

rows.jp: 感情をぶちまけただけ。

ghs.en: just throwing out all my feelings.

rows.jp: 「終わった」

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's over."

rows.jp: すべて。

ghs.en: All of it.

rows.jp: 世界に、俺は一人。

ghs.en: In the world, I am alone.

rows.jp: いるべき場所。

ghs.en: In the place I belong to,

rows.jp: 俺の聖域になった。

ghs.en: which I had made into my sanctuary.

rows.jp: 「……頑張ったね」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "...good job, you."

rows.jp: 「君か」

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's you."

rows.jp: しばらく出てこなかったのに。
rows.en: She hasn’t appeared in quite a while.

ghs.en: It has been some time since she last turned up.

rows.jp: 「だっこしてやろっか？」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Want me to hold you?"

rows.jp: 「そんな気分なんだけど……いいや」

ghs.en: Taichi: "I do feel like it but... nah."

rows.jp: 「今週は、曜子ちゃんのものだからな」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because this week is Youko-chan's alone."
Nanaka: "...right."

rows.jp: 俺の目は、もうこれが最後になるだろう。
rows.en: This will probably be the last time I see this.

ghs.en: For my eyes this will likely be the last time.

rows.jp: タペタムの機能が失われかけてる……のかな。
rows.en: Maybe my tapetum is starting to fail...

ghs.en: The function of the tapetum is being lost... maybe.

rows.jp: ゲートの存在が、以前より曖昧に見える。
rows.en: The gate looks fainter than it did before.

ghs.en: The existence of the gate appears more vague than before.

rows.jp: 目の機能が正常化すれば、観測することはできなくなるはずだ。
rows.en: Once my eyes return to normal, I shouldn’t be able to see it anymore.

ghs.en: If the function of my eyes normalizes, I'm sure I won't be able to observe it anymore.

rows.jp: リセットをすればともかく。

ghs.en: Unless reset, of course.

rows.jp: 俺に、そのつもりはなかった。
rows.en: I have no intention of doing that.

ghs.en: But I had no such intention.

rows.jp: 「そろそろだね」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "It's close, innit."

rows.jp: 「ああ、そろそろだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yup, it's close."

rows.jp: 「お疲れさま」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Cheers for your good work."

rows.jp: 「うん……ありがとう、母さん」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yeah... thanks, mother."

rows.jp: 「なはは」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Nahahah!"

rows.jp: 「じゃまた来週」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Well, see you next week."

rows.jp: 七香はかき消えた。あからさまに。

ghs.en: Nanaka disappeared. Overtly so.

rows.jp: 俺は気づく。

ghs.en: And I realized.

rows.jp: 「……母さん、だって？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...did I say, 'mother'?"

rows.jp: そして、世界は薄暮―――
rows.en: And the world sinks into twilight—

ghs.en: And then, the world was dusk---
